recommendations.title: Enhance Ad Relevance to Improve CTR
recommendations.whats_happening: The CTR is low at 4%, indicating that while traffic volume is decent, it may not be effectively engaging users.
what_you_should_do: Review ad copy and imagery to ensure they resonate with first-time investors
Test different headlines and calls to action in the Google Ads campaign
Conduct audience segmentation to tailor messaging for different segments
recommendations.why_this_matters: If we can improve the CTR, we will attract higher quality traffic, directly feeding the conversion funnel more effectively.

recommendations.title: Monitor and Adjust CPC Trends
recommendations.whats_happening: The CPC is at $1.26, which is moderate, but it could lead to inefficiencies if CTR and clicks do not improve.
what_you_should_do: Regularly monitor CPC alongside CTR and clicks at least weekly
If CPC rises without corresponding CTR improvement, pause or optimize underperforming ads
Reallocate budget from high CPC ads to those with better traffic performance
recommendations.why_this_matters: Keeping CPC in check ensures that we are not overspending without generating engaged traffic, which can drain resources.
recommendations.expected_impact: Potential CPC reduction of ~$0.20 if adjustments made timely and effectively.

recommendations.title: Test Landing Page Optimization
recommendations.whats_happening: Missing landing page views metrics mean we cannot assess the effectiveness of clicks, which is critical for understanding user engagement quality.
what_you_should_do: First, obtain landing page views metrics by integrating tracking for landing page visits
Implement A/B testing on landing page elements such as headlines, images, and CTAs to find effective combinations
recommendations.why_this_matters: Understanding how many visitors convert further down the funnel helps us refine traffic quality and improve overall campaign effectiveness.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved landing page conversion rates by 10-20% once optimized and reviewed based on new metrics.

recommendations.title: Reduce Impression-Click Discrepancy
recommendations.whats_happening: The high number of impressions (59886) versus clicks (2113) indicates that many users see the ads but are not engaged enough to click.
what_you_should_do: Analyze the current ad placements for relevance to the target audience  and optimize placement settings in Google Ads
Experiment with different bidding strategies to prioritize clicks over impressions
recommendations.why_this_matters: Addressing this gap is important to ensure that the ads are effectively attracting clicks, which directly relates to the traffic goal.
recommendations.expected_impact: Expected increase in click volume, potentially improving click-to-impression ratios by 5-10%.
